description: an old man archdruid with a long white beard braided with green leaves, a grand crown of tall antlers entwined with ivy and glowing green leaves, robes of moss, bark and oak leaves, a mantle of oak leaves and ivy, a belt of roots, no staff and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the antlers to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same character seen from the side: face, hair, headwear, clothes, armour, colours and drawing style; leave out the staff: the hands are empty
